name: NFI Port Logistics Port Wentworth GA

fieldNotes.imagery: Static Maxar satellite available via probe.ts captures the site MID-CONSTRUCTION (bare graded dirt, partially-erected steel/precast warehouse roofs, stacked construction materials, no final pavement striping). The facility opened Dec 5 2023; current imagery predates completion. Street View near the entrance is dated 2019-05 and shows raw, fenced vacant land (no operational coverage). Location, building footprint and graded property boundary are positively confirmed; gate-detail fields are inferred from facility type + documented specs and flagged.
fieldNotes.location: Positively confirmed as 120 Crossgate Road, Port Wentworth GA. The cross/T-shaped warehouse footprint in the imagery matches NFI's transload building; site sits on a peninsula bounded by the Savannah River (N/E) and the residential Crossgate neighborhood (W), <1 mi from GPA Garden City Terminal.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 308 shipping doors per NFI's published facility specs (counted as 50+ band). Two long dock faces visible on the building's main E-W bar and its N-S wing.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on different building faces (main bar south face + perpendicular wing), consistent with separate inbound/outbound transload flows.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 876 trailer spots per published specs plus 9,500-TEU container stacking; large graded drop-yard areas flank the building N and NE (50+ band). dropYard: true.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Inferred true: secured port transload container yard (9,500 TEU) is fenced (2019 SV shows full perimeter chain-link) with a single controlled access from the SE off Crossgate Road; small structures cluster at the SE corner of the truck court. Barrier arm not directly visible in construction imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred true: small structure cluster at the SE corner of the truck court (~32.1483,-81.1518) is consistent with a gatehouse/check-in; a manned booth is near-certain for a bonded/secured port container yard. Not directly confirmable in construction imagery.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs NW-SE along the western edge by the neighborhood but appears to be a through-line, not a spur into the property. railServed: false (drayage/transload by truck from the port terminal).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 in / 1 out from the wide access apron at the SE entrance; exact lane count not confirmable in construction imagery.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate apron and very large yard footprint leave ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial peninsula adjacent to a small residential neighborhood and the port; not dense metro fabric -> Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: 0 trailers visible because imagery predates operations (site under construction).
